prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "på grund av". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "because of".
Scene: Rain pours on an empty sports field; cancelled match represented by crossed-out ball symbol.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "på grund av = because of.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Matchen ställdes in på grund av regnet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
Use attached image as STYLE/LAYOUT reference only: warm photographic editorial scene, cream/gold heading, bold navy typography, gold memory caption and pale blue Swedish example strip. This card's supplied new scene and exact text, including å ä ö. Clear readable type fully inside margins. One square image.
